# Nine links in blog posts and a guide point at files that moved or no longer exist

**Claim it first:** comment on this issue before you start, and check the open pull requests for one that already points here. We merge the first approve-worthy PR (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`, point 3).

## Context

Welcome! This is a documentation fix with no code. You need a fork; the dev server helps you check the result.

Found in release testing of the Portal, 2026-10-20. Neo's Agent OS code (`ai/`) moved to its own repository, [neomjs/neo-agent-brain](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-brain). Several older posts still link to its old place in this repo, and those links now 404. Every path below was checked against `origin/dev`, and each moved file was found in `neo-agent-brain`'s `dev`.

## The Problem

| File:line on `origin/dev` 4844087a77 | Link target | Now |
|---|---|---|
| `learn/blog/Gemini3_MCP_Contributor.md:23` | `github.com/neomjs/neo/…/ai/mcp/server` | in neo-agent-brain |
| `learn/blog/ai-agents-runtime-possession.md:43`, `:145` | `…/neo/…/ai/mcp/server/neural-link/openapi.yaml` | in neo-agent-brain |
| `learn/blog/context-engineering-done-right.md:1879` | `…/neo/…/ai/mcp/server` | in neo-agent-brain |
| `learn/blog/context-engineering-done-right.md:39` | `…/neo/…/buildScripts/docs/jsdoc-x` | removed; in neither repository |
| `learn/blog/context-window-tax.md:364`, `:365` | `…/neo/…/ai/examples/migrate_timestamps.mjs`, `…/ai/examples/self-healing.mjs` | in neo-agent-brain |
| `learn/blog/cross-family-verification.md:115` | `neomjs.com/learn/benefits/brain/DeployingTheAgentOS` | no such page; the guide lives in neo-agent-brain, as `learn/benefits/Introduction.md` already links it |
| `learn/guides/datahandling/TreeStore.md:25` | `#reading-one-level` (an in-page anchor) | no element has that id. In the Portal the click does nothing, and a reload of the resulting URL shows an empty page |

## The Architectural Reality

- `ai/mcp/server`, `ai/mcp/server/neural-link/openapi.yaml`, `ai/examples/self-healing.mjs` and `ai/examples/migrate_timestamps.mjs` exist in `neomjs/neo-agent-brain` on `dev`.
- `buildScripts/docs/jsdoc-x` exists in neither repository.
- The Portal does not give Markdown headings ids, so an in-page `#anchor` link has nothing to jump to.

## The Fix

Re-point each `ai/` link to the same path under `https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-brain/blob/dev/` (or `tree/dev/` for a folder). Point the DeployingTheAgentOS link where `learn/benefits/Introduction.md` points. Remove or replace the `jsdoc-x` link. In `TreeStore.md`, name the section in words instead of linking an anchor that does not exist. Change no other text.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: every link in the table resolves (a 200 on GitHub, or a page in the Portal).
- [ ] AC-2: the diff changes only those link targets, plus the TreeStore sentence.

## Out of Scope

- Giving Markdown headings ids in the Portal, which is an engine change.

## Related

- `learn/benefits/Introduction.md` (the current DeployingTheAgentOS link).
